title: Content/widget results-matrix row
description: One row per built-in content type (US1, #6239) or per widget (US2 static shell, #6240; US3 dynamic interaction sibling rows reuse the widget suite with interaction cases). Rows are built by tests/helpers/content-create-matrix.js buildResultRow (US1) or tests/helpers/published-widget-matrix.js buildWidgetRow (US2) and validated by the matching validate function; the Playwright inventory/matrix specs fail when a row does not conform.

suite.description: Matrix suite that produced the row.

spec.description: Spec file that produced the row, module-relative (e.g. tests/content-create-matrix.spec.js).

contentType.description: Built-in content-type name as listed by GET /services/contenttypes (US1), or pinned widget name for the US2 static matrix (simple* covers the legacy simple list widgets).

label.description: Catalog label for the content type, or display label for the widget.

cell.description: QA cell the row was produced on. US1 runs on the CMS-only cell (no DTS dependency); US2 runs against the published site (needs the DTS publish path, PUBLISHED_SITE_URL).

createRoundTrip.description: Create via the editor New-item flow, then save and reopen with values round-tripped.

negativeRequired.description: Blank required field shows a visible message and persists nothing.

staticRender.description: Widget static output renders on its published fixture page with zero missing resources.

status.description: Row roll-up: fail wins over skip wins over pass.
